newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-JAILED FORMER FRENCH MINISTER IN BANKRUPTCY SALE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JAILED FORMER FRENCH MINISTER IN BANKRUPTCY SALE.

text.p: The forced sale of jailed and bankrupt former French politician and soccer boss Bernard Tapie's furniture netted 4.2 million francs ($740,000) at auction on Monday.
The best-selling items were a pair of Louis XIV marquetry chest of drawers which went together for 980,000 francs ($175,000).

Tapie, a former left-wing cabinet minister and business tycoon, was convicted of bribery and interfering with witnesses. He is currently serving an eight-month jail term, which began on February 3, for rigging a soccer match.
